description: Lightweight 2D game framework for .NET with batched rendering, asset protection (AES-GCM), pathfinding (A* + flow fields), coroutines, LDtk level editor support, encrypted saving, mod support, and post-processing shaders.
releaseNotes:
[1.2.0] 2026.9.7
      Added:
      * Added other datatypes for GetPropertyOrDefault and GetElementOrDefault
      * Added Rect2.Lerp and Rect2.SmoothStep with static/instance variants
      * Added epsilon guard in RaycastRect to prevent division by zero
      * Added LineRect with hit point/normal output
      * Added angle utilities to MathHelper (WrapAngle, WrapAngleDegrees, AngleDifference, MoveTowardsAngle)
      * Added Damp for exponential decay smoothing
      * Added Repeat for value wrapping in range
      * Added SmootherStep for 5th order interpolation
      * Added Frac for fractional part extraction
      * Added documentation for supported enum types and ulong limitation
      * Added missing Ninepatch and DrawText overloads

      Fixed:
      * Fixed visibility checks to account for scale and origin
      * Fixed the DrawCommandComparer to properly check for texture validity
      * Fixed MoveAndSlideRect corner sticking by separating X and Y axis collision resolution
      * Fixed MoveAndSlideCircle X axis position being overwritten instead of adding to velocity
      * Fixed LineLine edge cases (collinear lines, shared endpoints, point-on-line)
      * Fixed RaycastRect division by zero
      * Fixed swept collision hitPoint/hitNormal assignment
      * Fixed ClosestPointCircle center-point edge case
      * Fixed LDtk Array FilePath settings returning incorrect settings type
      * Fixed BeaconHandle TryGet returning true for value types when data type mismatch

      Changed:
      * Moved scale and origin to WriteQuadUnsafe where vertices are generated
      * Replaced push-based collision resolution with direct position snapping based on movement direction
      * Improved performance with deterministic 2-pass collision checks (X axis, then Y axis)
      * Made Rect2 interpolation delegate-compatible for Tween animation system
      * Updated EnumExtensions to support all enum underlying types via Convert.ToInt64
      * Reorganized SpriteBatcher public API for consistent parameter ordering
      * Extracted EngineDrawNinePatch to eliminate duplicate logic
      * Moved implementation details to private regions
      * Separated DrawAtlasDebugPage into dedicated region

      Removed:
      * Removed pre-scaling of dstRect in EngineDraw and EngineDrawBypassAtlas
      * Removed iteration parameter and simplified collision logic
      * Removed per-frame List allocations in MoveAndSlide methods
